newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares poised for recovery after FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares poised for recovery after FOMC.

text.p: Danish share prices opened slightly up on Wednesday and were expected by dealers to continue to rise moderately on the unchanged U.S. Federal Reserve's rates.

"Everything seems to point towards rises today but the weaker dollar might temper advances and there could still be a certain lingering uncertainty in the market about the longer term prospects for U.S. rates," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index had gained 0.19 point to 167.69 at 0705 gmt, having closed 0.42 point lower on Tuesday.
